title: Auth Control Plane membership update request (v1 wire format)
description: Body of a membership change: a new role, a new status, or both, against the revision the caller read. status cannot be set to invited (an invite creates that state). Ownership transfer is not part of this body.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

expected_revision.description: Aggregate revision (provisioning-event.v1 payload.revision). Integer token only; a decimal-form token is refused by every client (README, integer guard).

role.description: An organization role key of the closed catalog (contracts/auth/v1/vocabulary/roles.v1.json). A platform role, superuser and every other value are refused.
